finding: The official Rosstandart change card confirms that a correction exists and is effective, but does not disclose the correction text or identify the changed standard clause/table. The public secondary copy of the base standard is not sufficient evidence for deciding whether the provisional section catalog needs an update.
action: No catalog dimensions or recognition thresholds were changed. Keep the catalog provisional until the official correction page or controlled text is available.

acceptance.stage_8: open; current catalog cannot be signed off against the undisclosed IUS 10-2026 correction, and workshop physical labels/measurements and an agreed tolerance are also missing
